`paths.ensure_layout(home)` (`src/second_brain/paths.py:125`) creates every entry in `paths.MAJOR_DIRS`; `doctor.check_layout` (`src/second_brain/doctor.py:73`) reports the same list as missing, so the fix is to make `cmd_init`/doctor call `ensure_layout` idempotently.
Skill dirs in the home layout (`paths.py:38-50`): `skills/active`, `skills/candidates`, `skills/shadow`, `skills/staged`, `skills/approved/{global,domain,project,model}`, `skills/evals`, `skills/quarantine`, `skills/retired`, `skills/principles` (`paths.SKILL_LEVEL_DIRS` maps only candidates/shadow/active).
